description: This file defines a Java class 'StreamRetentionFragment' which extends Android support library's Fragment class. It handles storing and retrieving a 'CardStreamState' object, with lifecycle management related to activity creation.

classes.name: StreamRetentionFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that stores a 'CardStreamState' and preserves it across activity recreation.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Overrides Fragment lifecycle method to set the fragment to be retained across activity recreation.

methods.name: storeCardStream
methods.description: Stores a 'CardStreamState' object for later retrieval.
